# nocthost_gpu_plans (Data Source)

GPU sizes with specs, hourly prices and the regions they deploy in. Reads the public catalog (`GET /public/v1/gpus`), so no API token is needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GPU sizes with at least 48 GB of VRAM in Europe. No API token needed.
data "nocthost_gpu_plans" "big" {
  min_vram_gb = 48
  continent   = "Europe"
}

output "gpu_options" {
  value = [for p in data.nocthost_gpu_plans.big.plans : {
    plan_id     = p.id
    provider_id = p.provider_id
    gpu         = p.gpu_model
    hourly_usd  = p.price_per_hour_usd
    regions     = [for r in p.regions : r.id]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `continent` (String) Only regions on this continent, for example `Europe`.
- `gpu_model` (String) Only GPUs whose model contains this text, for example `L40S`.
- `max_hourly_usd` (Number) Only regions where the hourly price is at most this, USD.
- `min_vram_gb` (Number) Only sizes with at least this much total VRAM, GB.
- `provider_id` (String) Only sizes from this cloud backend, for example `linode`.

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) Matching GPU sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk, GB.
- `fractional` (Boolean) Whether the size gets a fraction of a GPU.
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs, null for shared or partitioned cards.
- `gpu_model` (String) GPU model.
- `id` (String) Size ID to use as `plan_id` on `nocthost_server`.
- `price_per_hour_usd` (Number) Lowest hourly price across regions, USD.
- `price_per_month_usd` (Number) Lowest monthly price across regions, USD.
- `provider_id` (String) Cloud backend ID to use as `provider_id`.
- `provider_name` (String) Cloud backend name.
- `ram_gb` (Number) RAM, GB.
- `regions` (Attributes List) Regions where this size deploys, with the price there. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans--regions))
- `vcpu` (Number) vCPU count.
- `vram_gb_per_gpu` (Number) VRAM per GPU, GB.
- `vram_gb_total` (Number) Total VRAM, GB.

<a id="nestedatt--plans--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans.regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City name.
- `continent` (String) Continent.
- `id` (String) Region code to use as `region_id`.
- `price_per_hour_usd` (Number) Hourly price in this region, USD.
- `price_per_month_usd` (Number) Monthly price in this region, USD.
